/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	TFAuditDate_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_AuditDateAuxDateText.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	&IsAuthorized_AuditDate = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'auditview_Execute')
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Audit'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	AuditId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	AuditDate.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	AuditTableName.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	AuditTableKey.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	AuditDescription.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	AuditShortDescription.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	GAMUserGUID.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	SecUserId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	AuditAction.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditId'
					&TFAuditId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFAuditId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditDate'
					&TFAuditDate.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFAuditDate_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFAuditDate_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFAuditDate_To.Set(&TFAuditDate_To.Year(), &TFAuditDate_To.Month(), &TFAuditDate_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditTableName'
					&TFAuditTableName = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFAuditTableName_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditTableKey'
					&TFAuditTableKey.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFAuditTableKey_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditDescription'
					&TFAuditDescription = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFAuditDescription_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditShortDescription'
					&TFAuditShortDescription = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFAuditShortDescription_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'GAMUserGUID'
					&TFGAMUserGUID = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFGAMUserGUID_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'SecUserId'
					&TFSecUserId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFSecUserId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'AuditAction'
					&TFAuditAction = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFAuditAction_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */ &Update = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Update) &Update.Link = WWPBaseObjects.Audit.Link(TrnMode.Update, AuditId) Endif &Delete = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Delete) &Delete.Link = WWPBaseObjects.Audit.Link(TrnMode.Delete, AuditId) Endif If (&IsAuthorized_AuditDate) AuditDate.Link = AuditView.Link(AuditId, '') Endif /* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
